intro: OwnX builds AI you control. Own1 is a personal AI computer for your home or office. Nexy is its assistant, on your laptop, your phone and in the cloud too. OwnX Console runs AI apps on servers you choose, and Earth Compute maps what that computing power costs around the world.

facts.label: Nexy Engine: one of the smallest AI agent engines
ways to run Nexy: Own1, Mac, Windows, Android, cloud, Docker
open-source apps one click away on OwnXOS
AI models bundled: Nexy uses the ones you already run

news.title: Your phone, powered by your gaming PC
news.text: A phone with no AI model of its own asked for an image. The Own1 passed the job to a gaming PC's graphics card and returned it in 17 seconds, about five times faster than the Own1 on its own. Every result says which device made it.

news.title: Nexy beta for Mac, Windows and Android
news.text: One download page with a step-by-step install guide. All three apps tell you when an update is ready.

news.title: Add a device with an 8-character code
news.text: Your Own1 shows a short code, you type it into Nexy, and you approve the device on the Own1 itself. Guest codes let family or a team use your Own1 within limits you set.

news.title: Independent security reviews before the beta
news.text: Two reviews of the apps, the web app, the agent engine and the Own1, before opening to testers. The issues found in the apps are fixed.

news.title: A new AI agent engine, built small
news.text: Written in Rust, it is one of the smallest agent engines around: a single 3.5 MB program that leaves the machine's memory to the AI model. Open source.

news.title: Open your Own1 from anywhere
news.text: The apps reach your Own1 over an encrypted network and sign in with a key only you hold. No router changes, no third-party cloud in the middle.

tracks.name: Own1
tracks.summary: A personal AI computer: the AI runs on the box, and your data stays on hardware you own.
highlights: AI employees that research, design, write and build, with owner approval before anything is published
Image, music, voice and website studios that run entirely on the box
tracks.next: Owner approval for every outbound action

tracks.name: OwnXOS
tracks.summary: The operating system under every Own1: each app in its own container, the whole system defined in one reproducible configuration.
highlights: One gateway shares the box's AI models between apps and devices
Every update is built and booted on a fresh box before release
tracks.next: Owner approval for every outbound action, and proof of which software each box runs

tracks.name: OwnX Desktop
tracks.summary: The desktop on every Own1: an app store, studios and AI employees, in owner or demo mode.
highlights: Signed in with a key only the owner holds
Now opens from the Nexy desktop and Android apps, over the private network
tracks.next: Its own AI service, fully separate from the demo

tracks.name: Nexy
tracks.summary: One assistant for chat, research, projects and routines, the same wherever you run it.
highlights: Runs on Own1, Mac, Android, Nexy Cloud and Docker
Researches the web and cites its sources
tracks.next: One request built across all your devices at once, shown live

tracks.name: Nexy Engine
tracks.summary: The agent behind Nexy: a new engine in Rust, built to stay out of the AI model's way.
highlights: One of the smallest agent engines: a 3.5 MB program
Works with any local AI model server; open source

tracks.name: Nexy for Mac and Windows
tracks.summary: Nexy as a desktop app: on your own computer, in Nexy Cloud, or on your Own1.
highlights: Mac and Windows beta, with automatic updates
Can share its graphics card with your Own1, so your other devices use it
tracks.next: Asking questions about a folder of documents

tracks.name: Nexy for Android and iPhone
tracks.summary: Nexy on your phone, powered by your own Own1 or Nexy Cloud. The phone needs no AI model of its own.
highlights: Android beta: add it to your Own1 with an 8-character code
Images and answers can be made on your own computers, through your Own1

tracks.name: Private network
tracks.summary: An encrypted network joining your devices, where each device's address comes from its own key.
highlights: Built into the Nexy apps, no setup or admin rights needed
Reaches an Own1 about three times faster than going through a public relay
tracks.next: Your devices sharing AI: a phone using your Own1's GPU

tracks.name: Nexy Cloud
tracks.summary: Nexy hosted for you, for anyone without an Own1 yet.
highlights: A private, isolated machine for each user
Answers on a trusted Own1 first, then on its own model
tracks.next: Accounts with passkey sign-in, then GPU credits

tracks.name: Earth Compute
tracks.summary: Live index of what compute, AI and infrastructure really cost, with a global map of data centers and an API.
highlights: Price history for GPUs, AI models, storage, RAM and bandwidth in today's dollars
Every data center on a searchable table and 3D map
Prices checked daily against providers' own price lists
tracks.next: Paid API access using the shared OwnX sign-in.

tracks.name: OwnX Console
tracks.summary: A console for running AI apps on servers you control, from choosing hardware to a live, one-click deploy.
highlights: One-click deploy with a live step log and a working link at the end
Live compute prices across data centre providers beside your own fleet
Builder workspace keeps client apps separate from your own servers
tracks.next: Personal sign-in with passkeys, then owner-only deploy controls.

tracks.name: OwnX CLI
tracks.summary: A command-line tool for your servers, with live prices from Earth Compute.
highlights: Apps, usage and logs for every server
Finds the cheapest compute or AI model, then deploys
tracks.next: More commands as OwnX Console grows

shipped.title: Every update tested on a brand-new Own1
shipped.benefit: Each change is built and booted on a fresh box before release, so new owners get exactly what was tested.

shipped.title: Leaner AI services, rewritten in Rust
shipped.benefit: Device pairing and the AI gateway now run as small, fast programs, leaving more of the box for the AI models.

shipped.title: Nexy Cloud answers on a trusted Own1
shipped.benefit: Cloud users get answers from a full-size model on an Own1 that has spare capacity, and every reply says where it ran.

shipped.title: One gateway for every AI model
shipped.benefit: A single service starts, shares and watches the box's models, and restarts one that stops responding.

shipped.title: Choose what each device can do
shipped.benefit: The owner sets a device's access when approving it, and can change it at any time.

shipped.title: Chat and images at the same time
shipped.benefit: The box keeps room for the text and image models together, so neither waits for the other.

shipped.title: One Nexy everywhere
shipped.benefit: Own1 runs the same Nexy as the apps and the web, so every improvement reaches every device at once.

shipped.title: A choice of agent engines
shipped.benefit: Owners can run Nexy Engine or one of two other open-source agents, each with its own tools.

shipped.title: Safer device pairing
shipped.benefit: Adding a device needs a recent owner sign-in and a single-use approval on the box.

shipped.title: Owner mode and demo mode, one system
shipped.benefit: The same software runs a private owner box or a public demo, so the demo shows the real product.

shipped.title: Devices page
shipped.benefit: Pair phones and laptops, hand out guest codes, and remove a device in one tap.

shipped.title: Your devices use your Own1's AI
shipped.benefit: Paired laptops and phones run on the box's models, with the owner always first in line.

shipped.title: Publish a page from your box
shipped.benefit: Share puts a saved page online and keeps it there until you unpublish it.

shipped.title: Nexy on Telegram
shipped.benefit: Message your Own1's assistant from Telegram.

shipped.title: Personal demo codes
shipped.benefit: Every visitor gets their own one-time code to try the demo desktop.

shipped.title: Turn a chat into a project
shipped.benefit: A conversation with several steps becomes a project you can come back to.

shipped.title: Take over the agent's browser
shipped.benefit: Watch the agent browse live, and take control yourself whenever you want.

shipped.title: Image jobs wait their turn
shipped.benefit: A queued image waits for the graphics card instead of failing.

shipped.title: AI employees that leave receipts
shipped.benefit: They work in their role, wait for your review and keep working with the tab closed.

shipped.title: Click any part of a page to edit it
shipped.benefit: Point at a heading or a footer and say what to change.

shipped.title: Every NixOS package, 365 self-hosted apps
shipped.benefit: Browse, ask Nexy about an app, and open it with one link.

shipped.title: Routines that run around the clock
shipped.benefit: A new routine runs straight away, then on its schedule.

shipped.title: Report a problem, kept on your box
shipped.benefit: Feedback is saved on the owner's own hardware, not sent away.

shipped.title: Nexy becomes the Own1 assistant
shipped.benefit: One always-on assistant across the whole desktop.

shipped.title: Edit the open page in place
shipped.benefit: Changes apply to the page you are looking at instead of rebuilding it.

shipped.title: Four conversations at once
shipped.benefit: The text model now serves four requests at the same time.

shipped.title: Sites fix their own broken images
shipped.benefit: A build repairs missing images and clipped labels instead of failing.

shipped.title: Add your data center
shipped.benefit: Data center operators can submit their facility from the Providers page and get a reference number straight away.

shipped.title: New API docs and API access requests
shipped.benefit: Developers get short, accurate API docs and can request access from the same page.

shipped.title: AI model prices refreshed hourly
shipped.benefit: AI model prices and their history in the API stay current through the day, not once a day.

shipped.title: Daily GPU price check
shipped.benefit: Every day, GPU prices are checked against the providers' own price lists, so the numbers people compare are ones they can actually buy at.

shipped.title: Price freshness on the Providers page
shipped.benefit: Each provider shows when it was last checked and when its prices last changed.

shipped.title: GPU price history by chip
shipped.benefit: For each GPU model, people can see how its price has moved across providers over time, in today's dollars.

shipped.title: AI image, video, audio and embedding price indexes
shipped.benefit: One index line per AI service type shows how its price has changed since launch, with each vendor switchable on or off.

shipped.title: Datacenters tab
shipped.benefit: Every facility on one searchable table, each row opening its own page with a 3D map.

shipped.title: Instrument detail API
shipped.benefit: Developers can pull the full figures behind any index page, including breakdowns, inventory and regions, in one call.

shipped.title: AI model catalogue in the API
shipped.benefit: Developers can query AI model prices and specs alongside compute, storage and network data.

shipped.title: One-click deploy with a live log
shipped.benefit: Press Deploy once to see each build step as it runs, then get a working link to the live app when it finishes.

shipped.title: Deploy plan on one screen
shipped.benefit: Before you deploy, you see the exact model, server and address the app will use, priced against the live compute market.

shipped.title: Builder workspace
shipped.benefit: Apps you build for clients sit in their own workspace, clearly separate from the servers and services you run yourself.

shipped.title: Public page for the sample hotel app
shipped.benefit: The sample hotel app now has a public home page where anyone can chat with its reservations assistant, with fair-use limits per visitor.

shipped.title: Organisation and project switcher
shipped.benefit: Move between organisations and projects in one click, with live project counts and a page for each project.

shipped.title: Fast first load
shipped.benefit: The console opens quickly, with compressed, cached assets and a placeholder layout while data arrives.

shipped.title: Agents, models and routing on real data
shipped.benefit: See your agents, models, inference routing, domains, a billing estimate and an architecture map built from your real servers, on desktop or phone.

shipped.title: Cheapest-first setup guide
shipped.benefit: A step-by-step guide suggests the lowest-cost server and model that fit your app before you commit.

shipped.title: Sample private AI reservations app
shipped.benefit: A ready-made example app with a private model, an inbox and an agent connector shows how to build and ship an AI app on your own server.

shipped.title: Fleet dashboard and Earth Compute prices
shipped.benefit: One read-only view of your servers' health and usage beside live compute prices across data centre providers, with keys and private details kept out of every answer.

shipped.title: Use a friend's Own1 for AI
shipped.benefit: Sync with someone else's Own1 for its AI only, with guest screens that show whose Own1 you're on.

shipped.title: Images from your Own1 on any device
shipped.benefit: Ask for an image from a phone or laptop and Nexy waits for your Own1, showing progress.

shipped.title: Only what your computer runs well
shipped.benefit: Nexy offers the features your model passed in our tests on a computer like yours, and points the rest to your Own1.

shipped.title: Reconnects by itself
shipped.benefit: If the link to your Own1 drops, Nexy reconnects on its own, and after an update it shows what changed.

shipped.title: Nexy for Windows beta
shipped.benefit: Windows joins Mac and Android, and every app tells you in your chat when an update is ready.

shipped.title: Simpler, safer pairing
shipped.benefit: Type your Own1's name and Nexy finds it; a new device joins only when you tap Allow.

shipped.title: Gmail and email-triggered routines
shipped.benefit: Connect Gmail read-only, and let a routine run when an email arrives, once you turn it on.

shipped.title: Your phone uses your Mac's Nexy
shipped.benefit: Scan a code and your phone runs on your Mac's AI; Nexy picks the best model the Mac can run.

shipped.title: Nexy 0.2 beta for Mac and Android
shipped.benefit: Run your own AI on your computer, or sync with your Own1 and use it from any device.

shipped.title: Prompts stay on your computer

shipped.title: Nexy apps that update themselves
shipped.benefit: Nexy for Mac and Android installs its own updates and reaches your Own1 over the private network.

shipped.title: Cheapest compute and AI from the terminal
shipped.benefit: Ask for the lowest-cost server or AI model from Earth Compute's live prices, ranked by provider and location.

shipped.title: Deploy from the terminal
shipped.benefit: A deploy command that checks the plan before anything changes.

shipped.title: Usage and logs for every app
shipped.benefit: CPU, memory and storage per app, and every service's logs, the same figures the console shows.

shipped.title: Works with both server versions
shipped.benefit: Runs against current and next-generation servers, and installs with one Nix command.

shipped.title: Your servers from the terminal
shipped.benefit: A command-line client shows your servers' apps, usage and logs, signed in with a key only you hold.

inReview.title: One address and one sign-in for the whole box
inReview.benefit: Every app on an Own1 opens from a single address after a single sign-in.

inReview.title: Agents ready on the very first boot
